objective: Run the E2E closure gate for seam S1 — batch lookup with 2 known and 1 unknown id returns 200 with per-id results, unknown = null, and the store is queried for all ids — and produce the gate evidence

concepts: store call counting via test double

frozen_contracts.spec: POST /profiles/batch body {ids: [str]} -> 200 {results: [{id, name} | null per id]}; more than 100 ids -> 422 error.code 'too_many_ids'

non_goals: No production code changes — gate defects are reported with seam location, not fixed here
implementation_constraints: The store is a test double that counts calls; the cache must be the real module

acceptance_tests.description: batch of 2 known + 1 unknown returns 200, 3 results, p-x null, store called once per id

failure_cases.scenario: gate E1 fails while unit suites are green
failure_cases.expected_behavior: record the failing gate + seam S1 + output in the checkpoint as a blocker

handoff.notes: Stage-closing checkpoint: remaining_dag empty, acceptance verdict in downstream_notes
